<Routes>

  <Route path="/" element={<ProfileLayout />}>

    <Route
      index
      element={<Navigate to="create-profile" />}
    />

    <Route
      path="create-profile"
      element={<CreateProfile />}
    />

    <Route
      path="otp-verification"
      element={<OtpVerification />}
    />

    <Route
      path="kyc-details"
      element={<KycDetails />}
    />

    <Route
      path="gst-details"
      element={<GstDetails />}
    />

    <Route
      path="bank-details"
      element={<BankDetails />}
    />

    <Route
      path="agreement"
      element={<Agreement />}
    />

    <Route
      path="profile-summary"
      element={<ProfileSummary />}
    />

  </Route>

</Routes>
